title: D1 track persistence foundation
purpose: Persist canonical SeshTrack records durably in SESH_DB while preserving the SESH-070A repository and compare-and-swap concurrency contract.

serialization.identityInvariant: row track_id, envelope recordId, payload id, and project_id must agree

boundaries: This slice does not mutate project.trackIds.
This slice does not authorize track creation, update, or deletion for a user.
This slice does not expose an HTTP API.
This slice does not add Studio UI.
This slice does not access R2 or audio bytes.
This slice does not grant public media authority.
This slice does not establish collaborator, copyright, publishing, master, management, licensing, royalty, or ownership rights.
Migration file creation does not authorize local or remote migration execution.
Production SESH_DB remains unchanged until separately and explicitly authorized.
